_: Notice types the mini bus feed is allowed to raise. No ERROR may appear here -
an error fails the build whatever this file says. Each entry needs a reason,
and an entry that stops occurring has to be removed.

reasons.missing_recommended_file: feed_info.txt. TransXChange carries no publisher, no version and no feed date range, so there is nothing to build one from and inventing it would be worse than the warning
reasons.same_name_and_description_for_route: a TransXChange line whose OutboundDescription is the service description, so route_long_name and route_desc agree. Only avoidable by dropping one of them, and both are what the source says
